GIMS Noida Staff Nurse Online Form 2026 – Extended - Complete Details

Short Information : Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS), Noida has released a notification for the recruitment of Staf Nurse Posts on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 100 posts. The online application process for GIMS Noida Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 has started from 10 August 2026, and candidates can apply until 30 October 2026 (Extended). Candidates are advised to check the complete details for GIMS Noida Staff Nurse Recruitment 2026 given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 August 2026
  • Last Date : 30 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1298/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 944/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
